additional_info.subject: NOTE FROM L3
additional_info.body:
Translation:
Following the start of a charging session at these stations (RVPT3170004587 and RVPT3170004586), we lost the connection. On Sifinity Control, restarting station RVPT3170004586 is possible, but the station does not restart.
We already encountered this problem at another station, and the circuit breaker at the main distribution board (TGBT) was tripped. We sent someone to verify that the settings were correct according to the calculations.
We have scheduled a visit from our service provider to check if the main distribution board circuit breaker is tripped. We are not requesting an on-site visit from you, just an analysis. Please let me know if you require any further information.
This is just a normal check if it was OCPP online or not. Both chargers are offline so until they are back there is nothing we can do

Thimon,
Following your report and after our checks, we can see that the charger is not active in Sifinity. The issue appears to be related to a network connection. We also checked the SCB and found that the SCB router is not functioning properly.
We think that we should go ahead with a site check of the router to identify the root cause and take the necessary actions to resolve it.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
